mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) during manufacturing slowdowns reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS below 390,000 million dollars) signals weak demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is below 390000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS above 2.0%), rising interest rates increase corporate borrowing costs and reduce equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high unemployment (UNRATE above 8.5%) consistently suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 94.0) indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 94.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
